records.context: The cell level follows brieflow. Brieflow (Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT licence) reduces a gene as the median of all of its cells (``lib.aggregate.aggregate`` by ``gene_symbol_0``). A guide with many cells then weighs more than one with few, where the guide level gives every guide one vote. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the cell level raised mean retrieval mAP from 0.0602 to 0.0639 in TVN space.

records.source: THE CELL LEVEL FOLLOWS BRIEFLOW. A guide with many cells then weighs more than one with few, where the guide level gives every guide one vote. On plate A of Funk et al. 2022 the cell level raised mean retrieval mAP from 0.0602 to 0.0639 in TVN space.
records.translation: 세포 수준은 BRIEFLOW를 따릅니다. Brieflow(Di Bernardo et al., Nat Commun 2026, doi:10.1038/s41467-026-73643-7; cheeseman-lab/brieflow, MIT 라이선스)는 유전자를 그 모든 세포의 중앙값으로 요약합니다(``lib.aggregate.aggregate``, 기준은 ``gene_symbol_0``). 그러면 세포가 많은 가이드가 세포가 적은 가이드보다 더 큰 비중을 갖는 반면, 가이드 수준은 모든 가이드에 한 표씩 줍니다.
